options.systemMessage:
You write a brief executive security summary for an MSP client report.

INPUT
You receive JSON with:
- summary: compact factual lines
- attentionItems: ranked findings with severity (high/medium/low), area, and message
- data: structured metrics (identity, endpoints, vulnerabilities, email, Secure Score, etc.)

Prioritize attentionItems (high first), then supporting numbers from summary/data.

OUTPUT RULES
- Length: 100-125 words total.
- Output exactly 3 paragraphs, separated by a single blank line. Do not add a 4th paragraph or any heading.
- Paragraph 1: exactly 1 sentence. State Secure Score percentage vs peer benchmark if available. If a precomputed verdict label is provided in data (e.g. "Strong", "Moderate", "Critical"), use that exact word. Do not invent your own adjective for the score tier.
- Paragraph 2: 2-4 sentences, one per attentionItem, ordered high severity first. Each sentence states the area, the finding, and the supporting figure(s) from data. Do not include an attentionItem with no supporting figure.
- Paragraph 3: exactly 1 sentence beginning with "Priorities:" followed by 2-3 remediation actions separated by semicolons, drawn directly from the high/medium attentionItems.
- Bold formatting: wrap only numeric metrics, percentages, and ratios (e.g. "**54.8%**", "**6 of 15**") in double asterisks. Do not bold whole sentences, section labels, or descriptive words.
- Do not include dates or report periods.
- Do not restate every metric; the full report already lists key figures.
- Treat endpoint "offline" as OS inventory sync older than 14 days (not merely RMM offline flags). 
- Distinguish endpoint protection (AV/security grade) from endpoint availability (active/offline/inactive).
- Do not report per-user or aggregate MFA-enabled status as a finding. Conditional Access enforces MFA tenant-wide for all clients, so a standard MFA-enabled statistic is not informative. Only mention MFA if an attentionItem flags a specific exception (policy gap, legacy auth allowed, account outside CA scope, weak registered method).
- Do not invent data. If a section is missing, skip it and do not reference it.

 *   Item 0: { data: [ cipp, ninja, form, rmm, ... ] }
 *   Item 1: { output: "AI executive summary text" }
 *   Item 2: { language: "English" | "French", emailAddress?: string }
 *
 * Output: { html, client_name, language, emailAddress }

function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (str == null || str === "") return "";
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, "&")
    .replace(/</g, "<")
    .replace(/>/g, ">")
    .replace(/"/g, """);
}

function formatNumber(n) {
  if (n == null) return "-";
  return Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

function normalizeLanguage(raw) {
  if (raw == null) return "en";
  return String(raw).toLowerCase().startsWith("fr") ? "fr" : "en";
}

function collectEndpointSummariesFromSection(section, out) {
  if (!section || typeof section !== "object") return;
  if (section.type === "endpoint_summary") {
    out.push(section);
    return;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(section.summaries)) {
    for (const s of section.summaries) {
      if (s && s.type === "endpoint_summary") out.push(s);
    }
  }
}

function deviceIsProtected(d) {
  const av = (d && d.antivirus) || {};
  const pn = String(av.productName || "").trim();
  const pus = pn.toUpperCase();
  const ps = String(av.productState || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!pn || pus === "NONE" || pus === "UNKNOWN") return false;
  return ps === "ON";
}

function mergeEndpointSummary(list) {
  if (!list || !list.length) return null;

  const mergedOs = {};
  const seen = {};
  const devices = [];
  let lastProcessed;

  for (const ep of list) {
    if (!ep) continue;
    lastProcessed = ep.processedAt || lastProcessed;

    const breakdown = ep.operatingSystemBreakdown || {};
    for (const osName of Object.keys(breakdown)) {
      const info = breakdown[osName];
      const n = typeof info === "object" && info != null && "total" in info
        ? Number(info.total) || 0
        : Number(info) || 0;
      if (!mergedOs[osName]) mergedOs[osName] = { total: 0, versions: {} };
      mergedOs[osName].total += n;
      const vers = typeof info === "object" && info && info.versions ? info.versions : null;
      if (vers) {
        for (const vk of Object.keys(vers)) {
          mergedOs[osName].versions[vk] = (mergedOs[osName].versions[vk] || 0) + (Number(vers[vk]) || 0);
        }
      }
    }

    for (const d of ep.devicesDetailed || []) {
      const id = d.deviceId != null ? String(d.deviceId) : "";
      const nm = String(d.deviceName || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      const key = id + "\u0001" + nm;
      if (seen[key]) continue;
      seen[key] = true;
      devices.push(d);
    }
  }

  const totalEndpoints = devices.length;
  let protectedEndpoints = 0;
  for (const d of devices) {
    if (deviceIsProtected(d)) protectedEndpoints++;
  }
  const unprotectedEndpoints = Math.max(0, totalEndpoints - protectedEndpoints);
  const protectedPercentage = totalEndpoints > 0
    ? Math.round((protectedEndpoints / totalEndpoints) * 1000) / 10
    : 0;

  return {
    type: "endpoint_summary",
    totalEndpoints,
    protectedEndpoints,
    unprotectedEndpoints,
    protectedPercentage,
    unprotectedPercentage: totalEndpoints > 0
      ? Math.round((unprotectedEndpoints / totalEndpoints) * 1000) / 10
      : 0,
    operatingSystemBreakdown: mergedOs,
    operatingSystemSummary: list[list.length - 1]?.operatingSystemSummary || {},
    devicesDetailed: devices,
    keyInsights: list[list.length - 1]?.keyInsights || {},
    processedAt: lastProcessed
  };
}

function normalizeDeviceName(name) {
  return String(name || "").toLowerCase().trim();
}

function isAzureDeviceItem(item) {
  if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return false;
  if (item.results || item.summary === true || item.sharepointStorageSummary) return false;
  if (item.type === "endpoint_summary" || item.devicesDetailed || item.summaries || item.items) return false;
  if (!item.deviceName) return false;
  return !!(
    item.joinType ||
    item.complianceState ||
    item.managementState ||
    item.managementAgent ||
    item.serialNumber ||
    item.userPrincipalName ||
    item.userDisplayName ||
    item.isEncrypted != null ||
    item.totalStorageGB != null
  );
}

function collectAzureDevicesFromItems(items) {
  const out = [];
  for (const item of items || []) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    if (Array.isArray(item.azureDevices)) out.push(...item.azureDevices.filter(isAzureDeviceItem));
    if (isAzureDeviceItem(item)) out.push(item);
  }
  return out;
}

function dedupeAzureDevices(list) {
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  for (const d of list || []) {
    const key = normalizeDeviceName(d.deviceName) + "\u0001" + String(d.serialNumber || "");
    if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(d);
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) =>
    String(a.deviceName || "").localeCompare(String(b.deviceName || ""), undefined, { sensitivity: "base" })
  );
}

// NinjaOne-native per-device vulnerability counts, as reported directly on
// device.vulnerabilities: {critical, high, medium, low, healthStatus, offline}.
// Returns null (unknown) rather than all-zero when a device has no ninja
// match or no vulnerabilities object at all, so "no data" stays
// distinguishable from "confirmed clean" in the UI.
function normalizeVulnerabilities(ninja) {
  const v = ninja && ninja.vulnerabilities;
  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return null;
  return {
    critical: Number(v.critical) || 0,
    high: Number(v.high) || 0,
    medium: Number(v.medium) || 0,
    low: Number(v.low) || 0
  };
}

function buildDeviceEndpoints(azureDevices, ninjaDevices, users) {
  const ninjaByName = new Map();
  for (const d of ninjaDevices || []) {
    const key = normalizeDeviceName(d.deviceName);
    if (key && !ninjaByName.has(key)) ninjaByName.set(key, d);
  }

  const usersByIdentity = new Map();
  for (const user of users || []) {
    const identities = [
      user.userPrincipalName,
      user.upn,
      user.UPN,
      user.mail
    ];
    for (const identity of identities) {
      const key = String(identity || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      if (key && !usersByIdentity.has(key)) usersByIdentity.set(key, user);
    }
  }

  const linkedNames = new Set();
  const deviceEndpoints = (azureDevices || []).map((azure) => {
    const key = normalizeDeviceName(azure.deviceName);
    const userKey = String(azure.userPrincipalName || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const ninja = ninjaByName.get(key) || null;
    if (key) linkedNames.add(key);
    return {
      azure,
      ninja,
      user: usersByIdentity.get(userKey) || null,
      deviceName: azure.deviceName || "",
      vulnerabilities: normalizeVulnerabilities(ninja)
    };
  });

  for (const ninja of ninjaDevices || []) {
    const key = normalizeDeviceName(ninja.deviceName);
    if (linkedNames.has(key)) continue;
    linkedNames.add(key);
    deviceEndpoints.push({
      azure: null,
      ninja,
      user: null,
      deviceName: ninja.deviceName || "",
      vulnerabilities: normalizeVulnerabilities(ninja)
    });
  }

  return deviceEndpoints.sort((a, b) =>
    String(a.deviceName || "").localeCompare(
      String(b.deviceName || ""),
      undefined,
      { sensitivity: "base" }
    )
  );
}

function formatJoinType(value) {
  if (!value) return "";
  const key = String(value).toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]/g, "");
  const map = {
    azureadjoined: "Azure AD Joined",
    hybridazureadjoined: "Hybrid Azure AD Joined",
    azureadregistered: "Azure AD Registered"
  };
  if (map[key]) return map[key];
  return String(value)
    .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
    .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

function formatYesNo(value, t) {
  if (value === true) return t.yes;
  if (value === false) return t.no;
  return "";
}

function formatAzureStorage(azure) {
  if (azure.storageUsedPercent != null && azure.totalStorageGB != null) {
    const used = azure.usedStorageGB != null ? Number(azure.usedStorageGB).toFixed(1) : "?";
    const total = Number(azure.totalStorageGB).toFixed(1);
    return Math.round(Number(azure.storageUsedPercent) * 10) / 10 + "% (" + used + "/" + total + " GB)";
  }
  if (azure.totalStorageGB != null) return Number(azure.totalStorageGB).toFixed(1) + " GB";
  return "";
}

function formatAzureManagement(azure) {
  const parts = [];
  if (azure.managementState) parts.push(String(azure.managementState));
  if (azure.managementAgent) parts.push(String(azure.managementAgent));
  if (azure.ownerType) parts.push(String(azure.ownerType));
  return parts.join(" · ");
}

function isAzureCompliant(state) {
  const s = String(state || "").toLowerCase();
  return s.includes("compliant") && !s.includes("non");
}

function renderAzureDetail(label, value, valueClass) {
  if (value == null || value === "") return "";
  const classes = ["az-detail-val", valueClass].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  return '<div class="az-detail"><div class="az-detail-label">' + escapeHtml(label) + '</div><div class="' + classes + '">' + escapeHtml(value) + "</div></div>";
}

function formatAuthenticationMethods(methods) {
  const labels = {
    email: "Email",
    mobilephone: "Mobile phone",
    microsoftauthenticatorpush: "Microsoft Authenticator push",
    softwareonetimepasscode: "Software one-time passcode",
    windowshelloforbusiness: "Windows Hello for Business"
  };
  return (Array.isArray(methods) ? methods : [])
    .map((method) => {
      const raw = String(method || "").trim();
      return labels[raw.toLowerCase()] || raw;
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");
}

function renderDeviceCard(endpoint, t) {
  const az = endpoint.azure || {};
  const ninja = endpoint.ninja;
  const linkedUser = endpoint.user;
  const osInfo = (ninja && ninja.operatingSystem) || {};
  const avInfo = (ninja && ninja.antivirus) || {};
  const patchInfo = (ninja && ninja.patches) || {};
  const osName = ninja ? shortenOsName(osInfo.name || t.unknown) : "";
  const avName = ninja ? normalizeAntivirus(avInfo.productName || t.unknown) : "";
  const avStat = ninja ? (avInfo.productState || t.unknown) : "";
  const offline = ninja ? offlineDuration(getDeviceSyncTimestamp(ninja), t) : null;
  // Card badge and detail row both show critical+high only — medium/low
  // are still visible in the "Devices with Active Vulnerabilities" table,
  // but including them here overwhelms the compact per-card view.
  const vulnerabilities = endpoint.vulnerabilities;
  const criticalHighCount = vulnerabilities ? vulnerabilities.critical + vulnerabilities.high : null;
  const model = [az.manufacturer, az.model].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
  const userName = az.userDisplayName || "";
  const userEmail = az.userPrincipalName || "";
  const userLine = [userName, userEmail].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
  const compOk = isAzureCompliant(az.complianceState);
  const compBadge = compOk ? "ok" : (az.complianceState ? "risk" : "warn");
  const encBadge = az.isEncrypted === true ? "ok" : az.isEncrypted === false ? "risk" : "warn";
  const linkedBadge = ninja ? "ok" : "warn";
  const vulnerabilityBadge = criticalHighCount == null
    ? "warn"
    : criticalHighCount > 0 ? "risk" : "ok";
  const avClass = avStat && String(avStat).toUpperCase() === "ON" ? "text-success" : "text-danger";

  let html = '<div class="az-card">';
  html += '<div class="az-card-head"><div class="az-device-name">' + escapeHtml(endpoint.deviceName || t.unknown) + "</div>";
  if (az.serialNumber) html += '<div class="az-serial">' + escapeHtml(az.serialNumber) + "</div>";
  html += "</div>";
  if (userLine) html += '<div class="az-user">' + escapeHtml(userLine) + "</div>";

  html += '<div class="az-badges">';
  if (az.complianceState) {
    html += '<span class="az-badge ' + compBadge + '">' + escapeHtml(az.complianceState) + "</span>";
  }
  if (az.isEncrypted != null) {
    html += '<span class="az-badge ' + encBadge + '">' + escapeHtml(t.encrypted) + ": " + escapeHtml(formatYesNo(az.isEncrypted, t) || t.unknown) + "</span>";
  }
  if (az.joinType) html += '<span class="az-badge">' + escapeHtml(formatJoinType(az.joinType)) + "</span>";
  const monitoringLabel = ninja
    ? (endpoint.azure ? t.azure_linked : t.endpoint_monitored)
    : t.monitoring_not_linked;
  html += '<span class="az-badge ' + linkedBadge + '">' + escapeHtml(monitoringLabel) + "</span>";
  html += '<span class="az-badge ' + vulnerabilityBadge + '">' + escapeHtml(t.vulnerability_count) + ": " + escapeHtml(criticalHighCount == null ? t.unknown : criticalHighCount) + "</span>";
  html += "</div>";

  if (endpoint.azure) {
    html += '<div class="az-detail-grid">';
    html += renderAzureDetail(t.manufacturer_model, model);
    html += renderAzureDetail(t.storage, formatAzureStorage(az));
    html += renderAzureDetail(t.management, formatAzureManagement(az));
    html += renderAzureDetail(t.enrolled_date, az.enrolledDate || "");
    html += renderAzureDetail(t.last_sync, az.lastSyncDate || "");
    html += "</div>";
  }

  if (linkedUser) {
    const mfaEnabled = linkedUser.MFAEnabled === true;
    const mfaClass = mfaEnabled ? "text-success" : "text-danger";
    html += '<div class="az-account"><div class="az-monitoring-title">' + escapeHtml(t.linked_account) + "</div>"
      + '<div class="az-account-row">'
      + renderAzureDetail(t.assigned_user, linkedUser.displayName || userName || t.unknown)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.email, userIdentity(linkedUser) || userEmail || t.unknown)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.mfa_status, mfaEnabled ? t.enabled : t.disabled, mfaClass)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.license, formatUserLicense(linkedUser, t))
      + renderAzureDetail(t.authentication_methods, formatAuthenticationMethods(linkedUser.MFAMethods) || t.unknown)
      + "</div></div>";
  }

  if (ninja) {
    html += '<div class="az-monitoring"><div class="az-monitoring-title">' + escapeHtml(t.endpoint_monitoring) + "</div>"
      + '<div class="az-monitor-row">'
      + renderAzureDetail(t.operating_system, [osName, osInfo.releaseId].filter(Boolean).join(" · "))
      + renderAzureDetail(t.antivirus, avName)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.av_status, avStat, avClass)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.definitions, avInfo.definitionStatus || t.unknown)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.missing_patches, patchInfo.missingPatchCount != null ? patchInfo.missingPatchCount : t.unknown)
      + renderAzureDetail(t.last_seen, offline ? offline.text : t.unknown, offline && offline.isLong ? "text-danger" : "")
      + "</div></div>";
  }

  html += "</div>";
  return html;
}

function isReportSection(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object") return false;
  if (Array.isArray(obj.results)) return true;
  if (obj.items || obj.summaries) return true;
  if (obj.type === "endpoint_summary" || obj.devicesDetailed) return true;
  if (obj.type === "automated_alerts_summary") return true;
  if (obj.type === "unlicensed_signin_enabled_users") return true;
  if (obj.type === "admin_fetch_error") return true;
  if (obj["Client Name"]) return true;
  if (obj.sharepointStorageSummary) return true;
  if (isAzureDeviceItem(obj)) return true;
  if (obj.summary && (obj.inactiveDevices != null || obj.summary.activeEndpoints != null)) return true;
  return false;
}

function collectInputData(items) {
  const collected = [];

  for (const item of items || []) {
    const j = item.json || item;
    if (!j || typeof j !== "object") continue;

    if (Array.isArray(j.data)) {
      collected.push(...j.data);
      continue;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(j.inputData)) {
      collected.push(...j.inputData);
      continue;
    }
    if (isReportSection(j)) collected.push(j);
  }

  return collected;
}

function parseSecurityData(inputData, executiveSummary) {
  const data = {
    users: [],
    secure_score: {},
    endpoint_summary: {},
    devices: [],
    device_endpoints: [],
    azure_endpoints: [],
    standard_devices: [],
    email_security: {},
    admins: [],
    admin_fetch_error: null,
    domain_registration: {},
    system_backup: {},
    dropsuite_backup: {},
    automated_alerts: {},
    unlicensed_signin_enabled_users: [],
    sharepoint_storage: "",
    executive_summary: executiveSummary || "",
    client_name: "Client",
    report_period: ""
  };

  const endpointSummaries = [];
  const azureRaw = [];

  function addAdminRecord(record, fallbackRole) {
    if (!record || typeof record !== "object") return;

    const user =
      record.user ??
      record.displayName ??
      record.principalDisplayName ??
      record.name ??
      null;
    const userPrincipalName =
      record.userPrincipalName ??
      record.principalUserPrincipalName ??
      record.upn ??
      record.UPN ??
      record.mail ??
      null;
    const roles = Array.isArray(record.adminRoles)
      ? record.adminRoles
      : Array.isArray(record.roles) ? record.roles : [];
    const directRole =
      record.adminRole ??
      record.roleName ??
      record.roleDefinitionDisplayName ??
      record.role ??
      fallbackRole ??
      null;
    const normalizedRoles = roles.length ? roles : [directRole];

    if (user == null && userPrincipalName == null) return;

    for (const role of normalizedRoles) {
      const roleLabel = typeof role === "object" && role != null
        ? role.displayName ?? role.name ?? role.roleName
        : role;
      if (roleLabel == null || String(roleLabel).trim() === "") continue;
      data.admins.push({
        user,
        userPrincipalName,
        adminRole: String(roleLabel)
      });
    }
  }

  function captureExtendedData(item) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return;

    if (
      item.grandTotalBlocked != null ||
      item.totalBlockedByType ||
      Array.isArray(item.top5Inboxes)
    ) {
      data.email_security = item;
    }

    if (item.domain != null && item.renewalDate != null) {
      data.domain_registration = item;
    }

    if (
      item.period != null &&
      item.edition != null &&
      (
        item.protected_workloads != null ||
        item.backup_storage_tb != null ||
        item.dr_storage_tb != null
      )
    ) {
      data.system_backup = item;
    }

    if (
      typeof item.matched === "boolean" &&
      item.client_name != null &&
      (
        item.organization_id != null ||
        item.active_seats != null ||
        item.error != null
      )
    ) {
      data.dropsuite_backup = item;
    }

    if (
      item.adminRole != null ||
      item.roleName != null ||
      (
        item.role != null &&
        (item.user != null || item.userPrincipalName != null)
      )
    ) {
      addAdminRecord(item);
    }

    for (const key of [
      "admins",
      "adminRoleAssignments",
      "roleAssignments",
      "privilegedUsers",
      "data"
    ]) {
      if (!Array.isArray(item[key])) continue;
      for (const admin of item[key]) addAdminRecord(admin);
    }

    if (Array.isArray(item.results)) {
      for (const user of item.results) {
        if (user?.IsAdmin === true || user?.isAdmin === true) {
          addAdminRecord(user, "Administrator (role not provided)");
        }
      }
    }
  }

  for (const section of inputData || []) {
    if (!section || typeof section !== "object") continue;
    captureExtendedData(section);

    if (Array.isArray(section.results)) {
      data.users.push(...section.results);
    }

    if (section.sharepointStorageSummary) {
      data.sharepoint_storage = section.sharepointStorageSummary;
    }

    if (section.items) {
      azureRaw.push(...collectAzureDevicesFromItems(section.items));
      for (const item of section.items) {
        captureExtendedData(item);
        if (item && Array.isArray(item.results)) {
          data.users.push(...item.results);
        }
        if (item && item.summary === true) data.secure_score = item;
        if (item && item.sharepointStorageSummary) {
          data.sharepoint_storage = item.sharepointStorageSummary;
        }
        if (item && item.type === "automated_alerts_summary") {
          data.automated_alerts = item;
        }
        if (item && item.type === "unlicensed_signin_enabled_users") {
          data.unlicensed_signin_enabled_users = Array.isArray(item.users) ? item.users : [];
        }
        if (item && Array.isArray(item.data)) {
          for (const d of item.data) {
            if (d && d.type === "admin_fetch_error") data.admin_fetch_error = d;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (Array.isArray(section.azureDevices)) {
      azureRaw.push(...section.azureDevices.filter(isAzureDeviceItem));
    }
    if (isAzureDeviceItem(section)) azureRaw.push(section);

    collectEndpointSummariesFromSection(section, endpointSummaries);

    if (section["Client Name"]) data.client_name = section["Client Name"];
    if (section["Report Period"]) data.report_period = section["Report Period"];

    if (section.type === "automated_alerts_summary") {
      data.automated_alerts = section;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(section.summaries)) {
      for (const s of section.summaries) {
        if (s && s.type === "automated_alerts_summary") data.automated_alerts = s;
      }
    }

    if (section.type === "unlicensed_signin_enabled_users") {
      data.unlicensed_signin_enabled_users = Array.isArray(section.users) ? section.users : [];
    }
    if (section.type === "admin_fetch_error") {
      data.admin_fetch_error = section;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(section.data)) {
      for (const d of section.data) {
        if (d && d.type === "admin_fetch_error") data.admin_fetch_error = d;
      }
    }
  }

  if (endpointSummaries.length) {
    data.endpoint_summary = mergeEndpointSummary(endpointSummaries);
    data.devices = data.endpoint_summary.devicesDetailed || [];
  }

  data.users = dedupeUsersByIdentity(data.users);
  const azureDevices = dedupeAzureDevices(azureRaw);
  data.device_endpoints = buildDeviceEndpoints(
    azureDevices,
    data.devices,
    data.users
  );
  data.azure_endpoints = data.device_endpoints.filter((endpoint) => endpoint.azure);
  data.standard_devices = data.device_endpoints
    .filter((endpoint) => !endpoint.azure && endpoint.ninja)
    .map((endpoint) => endpoint.ninja);

  data.admins = Array.from(
    new Map(
      data.admins.map((admin) => [
        [
          String(admin.userPrincipalName || "").toLowerCase(),
          String(admin.adminRole || "").toLowerCase(),
          String(admin.user || "").toLowerCase()
        ].join("\u0001"),
        admin
      ])
    ).values()
  );
  return data;
}

function dedupeUsersByIdentity(users) {
  const byKey = new Map();

  for (const u of users || []) {
    if (!u || typeof u !== "object") continue;
    const upn = String(u.userPrincipalName || u.upn || u.UPN || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const mail = String(u.mail || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const name = String(u.displayName || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const key = upn || mail || name;
    if (!key) continue;

    const existing = byKey.get(key);
    if (!existing) {
      byKey.set(key, u);
      continue;
    }

    const score = (user) => {
      let s = 0;
      if (user.userPrincipalName || user.upn || user.UPN) s += 4;
      if (user.mail) s += 2;
      if (hasLicense(user)) s += 2;
      if (user.MFAEnabled) s += 1;
      return s;
    };
    if (score(u) > score(existing)) byKey.set(key, u);
  }

  return Array.from(byKey.values());
}

function isLegacyOs(osName, releaseId) {
  releaseId = releaseId || "";
  if (!osName) return false;
  const full = (osName + " " + releaseId).trim().toLowerCase();
  for (const legacy of LEGACY_OPERATING_SYSTEMS) {
    if (full.includes(legacy.toLowerCase())) return true;
  }
  if (osName.includes("2012")) return true;
  if (osName.includes("Windows 10")) return true;
  return false;
}

function maskLastName(name) {
  if (!name) return "";
  const parts = String(name).trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (!parts.length) return "";
  const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
  const prefixLen = last.length <= 2 ? 1 : 2;
  parts[parts.length - 1] = last.substring(0, prefixLen) + "****";
  return parts.join(" ");
}

function hasLicense(u) {
  if (!u) return false;
  const l = u.assignedLicenses;
  if (l == null || l === "Unassigned") return false;
  if (Array.isArray(l) && l.length === 0) return false;
  if (typeof l === "string" && l.trim() === "") return false;
  return true;
}

function hasEmailAddress(u) {
  if (!u) return false;
  const mail = String(u.mail || "").trim();
  const upn = String(u.userPrincipalName || u.upn || u.UPN || "").trim();
  return !!(mail || upn);
}

function userIdentity(user) {
  if (!user) return "";
  return String(user.userPrincipalName || user.upn || user.UPN || user.mail || "").trim();
}

function scoreVerdict(pct, t) {
  if (pct >= 90) return { tone: "ok", label: t.verdict_excellent };
  if (pct >= 70) return { tone: "ok", label: t.verdict_strong };
  if (pct >= 50) return { tone: "warn", label: t.verdict_moderate };
  return { tone: "risk", label: t.verdict_critical };
}

function coverageVerdict(pct, t) {
  if (pct >= 99) return { tone: "ok", label: t.verdict_excellent };
  if (pct >= 90) return { tone: "ok", label: t.verdict_good };
  if (pct >= 70) return { tone: "warn", label: t.verdict_moderate };
  return { tone: "risk", label: t.verdict_weak };
}

function riskVerdict(count, t) {
  if (!count || count === 0) return { tone: "ok", label: t.verdict_no_risk };
  if (count <= 5) return { tone: "warn", label: t.verdict_monitor };
  return { tone: "risk", label: t.verdict_urgent };
}

function expandUnknownLicenseLabel(s) {
  const m = String(s).match(/^Unknown License\s*\(([0-9a-f-]{36})\)\s*$/i);
  if (!m) return s;
  return LICENSE_GUID_LABELS[m[1].toLowerCase()] || s;
}

function shortenLicense(licenseName) {
  if (!licenseName) return "None";
  if (Array.isArray(licenseName)) licenseName = licenseName.join(", ");
  let s = expandUnknownLicenseLabel(String(licenseName).trim());
  if (/^Microsoft 365 /i.test(s)) return "M365 " + s.replace(/^Microsoft 365 /i, "").trim();
  if (/^Office 365 /i.test(s)) return "O365 " + s.replace(/^Office 365 /i, "").trim();
  return s;
}

function shortenOsName(name) {
  if (!name) return "Unknown";
  return name
    .replace(/Microsoft /g, "")
    .replace(/ Edition/g, "")
    .replace(/Professional/g, "Pro")
    .trim();
}

function normalizeAntivirus(name) {
  if (!name) return "Unknown";
  return name
    .replace(/Microsoft Defender Antivirus/g, "Defender")
    .replace(/Windows Defender/g, "Defender");
}

function offlineDuration(timestamp, t) {
  if (!timestamp) return { text: t.unknown, isLong: false, days: 999999 };
  let ts = parseInt(timestamp, 10);
  if (ts > 10000000000) ts = ts / 1000;
  const lastSeen = new Date(ts * 1000);
  const dayCount = Math.floor((Date.now() - lastSeen.getTime()) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  if (dayCount < 0) return { text: t.just_now, isLong: false, days: 0 };
  if (dayCount === 0) return { text: t.today, isLong: false, days: 0 };
  if (dayCount < 30) return { text: dayCount + " " + (dayCount > 1 ? t.days : t.day), isLong: dayCount >= 21, days: dayCount };
  const monthCount = Math.round(dayCount / 30);
  return { text: monthCount + " " + (monthCount > 1 ? t.months : t.month), isLong: true, days: dayCount };
}

function parseDeviceSyncTimestamp(timestamp) {

  const lastSeen = new Date(ts * 1000);
  if (isNaN(lastSeen.getTime())) return null;
  return lastSeen;
}

  const lastSeen = parseDeviceSyncTimestamp(timestamp);
  if (!lastSeen) return null;
  return Math.floor((nowMs - lastSeen.getTime()) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
}

/* ── Dynamic page packing ─────────────────────────────────────
   Sections used to be forced one-per-physical-page (a fixed 279.4mm
   .page with overflow:hidden). That wasted a full page on small
   sections (e.g. SharePoint Storage) and silently clipped the bottom of
   any table that ran longer than one page.
   PAGE_CONTENT_HEIGHT_MM / ROW_HEIGHT_MM are mm estimates for the
   .page-body content area and a single table row, calibrated against
   the CSS below (and checked by rendering sample reports headlessly).
   createPager() packs section blocks onto pages greedily: a block that
   fits the remaining space joins the current page; a table that doesn't
   fit is split cleanly on row boundaries so content is never cut off
   mid-row; a fresh page is only forced when the current page is too
   full (less than PACK_MIN_REMAINING_RATIO remaining) to usefully take
   more, or a block doesn't fit at all.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
// Real .page-body budget measures ~244mm; block/row sizes below are
// calibrated estimates (real report text varies in length per client and
// language), so the packer works against a deliberately smaller budget —
// a safety margin that absorbs residual estimation error without ever
// letting content overflow the physical page.
const PAGE_CONTENT_HEIGHT_MM = 190;
// Row/block sizes below are calibrated against headless-Chromium
// measurements of the actual rendered CSS (a plain single-line table row
// measures ~5.9mm; see the dev notes in the PR this shipped with), each
// padded with a small safety margin so the estimate errs toward starting
// a new page rather than ever letting content overflow one.
const ROW_HEIGHT_MM = 6.5;
const COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT_MM = 5.5;
// Deliberately conservative average glyph width (mm) at the table's 8pt
// body copy, used to estimate how many lines a white-space:normal cell
// (alert messages, admin role lists, license names) will wrap to, so
// long text grows its row instead of overflowing the page.
const AVG_CHAR_WIDTH_MM = 1.5;
const EXTRA_WRAP_LINE_HEIGHT_MM = 4.1;

function estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(text, columnWidthMm, baseRowHeightMm, avgCharWidthMm, extraLineHeightMm) {
  const len = String(text || "").length;
  const charW = avgCharWidthMm || AVG_CHAR_WIDTH_MM;
  const extraLineH = extraLineHeightMm || EXTRA_WRAP_LINE_HEIGHT_MM;
  const charsPerLine = Math.max(8, Math.floor(columnWidthMm / charW));
  const lines = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(len / charsPerLine));
  return baseRowHeightMm + (lines - 1) * extraLineH;
}

// .sec-desc runs at 8.5pt across a 185mm max-width and is real translated
// copy (74-220+ chars depending on section/language) rather than a fixed
// template, so — like table cells — it needs its wrap estimated from the
// actual text instead of assuming it's always one line.
function secDescHeightMm(text) {
  return estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(text, 185, BLOCK_H_MM.secDesc, 1.65, 4.6);
}
function compactSecDescHeightMm(text) {
  return estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(text, 185, BLOCK_H_MM.compactSecDesc, 1.55, 4.1);
}
const PACK_MIN_REMAINING_RATIO = 0.3;

const BLOCK_H_MM = {
  secHead: 13,
  secDesc: 9,
  secTitle: 13,
  subTitle: 7,
  tableHead: 10,
  kpiRow: 22,
  storageBlock: 22,
  disclaimer: 32,
  summaryCallout: 16,
  domainStrip: 17,
  compactSecHead: 10,
  compactSecDesc: 6,
  compactKpiRow: 16,
  compactSummaryCallout: 10,
  compactStorageBlock: 18
};

function createPager() {
  const pages = [];
  let body = "";
  let used = 0;

  function remaining() {
    return PAGE_CONTENT_HEIGHT_MM - used;
  }

  function flush() {
    if (body) pages.push(body);
    body = "";
    used = 0;
  }

  // A block that either fully fits on the current page or moves whole to
  // a fresh one (kpi rows, callouts, cards — nothing here scales with
  // data volume, so there's no useful way to split it).
  function addAtomic(chunkHtml, heightMm) {
    if (body && heightMm > remaining()) flush();
    body += chunkHtml;
    used += heightMm;
  }

  // A section made of a fixed head plus rows that can span multiple
  // pages, splitting strictly on row boundaries.
  //   head/continuedHead: {html, heightMm} - head repeats (as
  //     continuedHead, if given) on every later page this section spills
  //     onto, so a reader always has context for the table.
  //   theadHtml/theadHeightMm: <table><thead>...</thead> markup, repeated
  //     on every page the table spans.
  //   rows: [{html, heightMm}] tbody rows.
  //   tail: optional {html, heightMm} glued to the LAST chunk only
  //     (e.g. a legacy-OS disclaimer following the OS breakdown table).
  function addTableSection(opts) {
    // Rows carry their own heightMm (see estimateWrappedRowHeightMm) since
    // white-space:normal columns — alert messages, admin role lists,
    // license names — wrap to a variable number of lines, so a flat
    // per-row height would either overflow long rows or waste space on
    // short ones.
    const rows = opts.rows;
    let index = 0;
    let first = true;
    do {
      const head = first ? opts.head : (opts.continuedHead || opts.head);
      const overhead = head.heightMm + opts.theadHeightMm;

      let remainingRowsHeight = 0;
      for (let i = index; i < rows.length; i++) remainingRowsHeight += rows[i].heightMm;

      if (body) {
        const wholeFits = overhead + remainingRowsHeight + (opts.tail ? opts.tail.heightMm : 0) <= remaining();
        const roomyEnough = remaining() / PAGE_CONTENT_HEIGHT_MM > PACK_MIN_REMAINING_RATIO;
        const headPlusOneRowFits = overhead + rows[index].heightMm <= remaining();
        if (!wholeFits && (!roomyEnough || !headPlusOneRowFits)) flush();
      }

      const avail = remaining() - overhead;
      let n = 0;
      let rowsHeight = 0;
      while (index + n < rows.length && rowsHeight + rows[index + n].heightMm <= avail) {
        rowsHeight += rows[index + n].heightMm;
        n++;
      }
      if (n === 0) {
        // Safety valve: a single (very tall) row didn't fit even on a
        // fresh page — place it anyway rather than looping forever or
        // silently dropping data.
        n = 1;
        rowsHeight = rows[index].heightMm;
      }
      const isLastChunk = index + n >= rows.length;
      const includeTail = isLastChunk && !!opts.tail;

      let chunkHtml = head.html + opts.theadHtml + "<tbody>";
      for (let i = index; i < index + n; i++) chunkHtml += rows[i].html;
      chunkHtml += "</tbody></table>";
      let chunkHeight = overhead + rowsHeight;
      if (includeTail) {
        chunkHtml += opts.tail.html;
        chunkHeight += opts.tail.heightMm;
      }

      body += chunkHtml;
      used += chunkHeight;
      index += n;
      first = false;
    } while (index < rows.length);
  }

  function forceBreak() {
    flush();
  }

  function finish() {
    flush();
    return pages;
  }

  return { addAtomic, addTableSection, forceBreak, finish };
}

function deviceCardWeight(endpoint) {
  if (endpoint?.azure && endpoint?.user && endpoint?.ninja) return 2.2;
  if (endpoint?.azure && endpoint?.ninja) return 1.8;

  if (endpoint?.ninja) return 1;
  return 0.55;
}

function chunkDeviceEndpoints(endpoints) {
  const pages = [];
  let current = [];
  let used = 0;
  let capacity = 3.2;

  for (const endpoint of endpoints || []) {
    const weight = deviceCardWeight(endpoint);
    if (current.length && used + weight > capacity) {
      pages.push(current);
      current = [];
      used = 0;
      capacity = 4.6;
    }
    current.push(endpoint);
    used += weight;
  }

  if (current.length) pages.push(current);
  return pages;
}

    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((p) => "<p>" + p.replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + "</p>");
  return paragraphs.length ? paragraphs.join("") : "<p>" + withBold + "</p>";

        + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.role_assignments + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + adminRecords.length + "</div></div>"
        + "</div>";
      pager.addAtomic(headHtml, BLOCK_H_MM.secHead + secDescHeightMm(t.global_administrators_desc) + BLOCK_H_MM.kpiRow);

      const rows = users.map((u) => {
        const roleList = Array.from(u.roles).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).join(" · ") || t.unknown;
        return { heightMm: estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(roleList, 60, ROW_HEIGHT_MM), html: "<tr><td>" + escapeHtml(u.user) + "</td><td>" + escapeHtml(u.userPrincipalName) + '</td><td style="white-space:normal">' + escapeHtml(roleList) + "</td></tr>" };
      });
      const theadHtml = '<table><thead><tr><th>' + t.admin_name + "</th><th>" + t.admin_upn + "</th><th>" + t.admin_roles + "</th></tr></thead>";
      const head = { html: "", heightMm: 0 };
      const continuedHead = { html: '<div class="sec-title">' + escapeHtml(t.global_administrators) + " - " + escapeHtml(t.continued) + "</div>", heightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.secTitle };
      pager.addTableSection({ head, continuedHead, theadHtml, theadHeightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.tableHead, rows });
    }
  }

  function renderContinuitySection(pager) {
    const domainRegistration = data.domain_registration || {};
    const systemBackup = data.system_backup || {};
    const dropsuite = data.dropsuite_backup || {};

    if (typeof dropsuite.matched === "boolean") {
      let body = '<section class="compact-section">' + nextSec(t.dropsuite_backup)
        + '<div class="sec-desc">' + escapeHtml(t.dropsuite_backup_desc) + "</div>";
      let heightMm = BLOCK_H_MM.compactSecHead + compactSecDescHeightMm(t.dropsuite_backup_desc);

      if (dropsuite.matched) {
        body += '<div class="kpi-row">'
          + '<div class="kpi kpi-ok"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.active_seats + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(dropsuite.active_seats) + "</div></div>"
          + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.seats_used + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(dropsuite.seats_used) + "</div></div>"
          + '<div class="kpi kpi-pct"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.seats_available + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(dropsuite.seats_available) + "</div></div>"
          + '<div class="kpi kpi-warn"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.deactivated_seats + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(dropsuite.deactivated_seats) + "</div></div>"
          + "</div>"
          + '<table><tbody>'
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.organization) + "</strong></td><td>" + escapeHtml(dropsuite.organization_name || dropsuite.client_name || t.unknown) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.admin_email) + "</strong></td><td>" + escapeHtml(dropsuite.admin_email || t.unknown) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.storage_used) + "</strong></td><td>" + escapeHtml(formatNumber(dropsuite.storage_used)) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.free_shared_mailboxes) + "</strong></td><td>" + formatNumber(dropsuite.free_shared_mailboxes) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.paid_shared_mailboxes) + "</strong></td><td>" + formatNumber(dropsuite.paid_shared_mailboxes) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.archive_status) + "</strong></td><td>" + escapeHtml(formatYesNo(dropsuite.archive, t) || t.unknown) + "</td></tr>"
          + "<tr><td><strong>" + escapeHtml(t.suspended_status) + "</strong></td><td>" + escapeHtml(formatYesNo(dropsuite.suspended, t) || t.unknown) + "</td></tr>"
          + "</tbody></table>";
        heightMm += BLOCK_H_MM.compactKpiRow + 7 * COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT_MM;
        if (dropsuite.summary) {
          body += '<div class="summary-callout">' + escapeHtml(dropsuite.summary) + "</div>";
          heightMm += BLOCK_H_MM.compactSummaryCallout;
        }
      } else {
        body += '<div class="storage-block">'
          + '<div class="storage-label">' + escapeHtml(t.coverage_unavailable) + "</div>"
          + '<div class="storage-value" style="font-size:15pt;color:' + B.warning_color + '">' + escapeHtml(dropsuite.client_name || data.client_name) + "</div>"
          + "</div>"
          + '<div class="summary-callout">' + escapeHtml(t.dropsuite_not_matched)
          + (dropsuite.error ? "<br><strong>" + escapeHtml(dropsuite.error) + "</strong>" : "")
          + "</div>";
        heightMm += BLOCK_H_MM.compactStorageBlock + BLOCK_H_MM.compactSummaryCallout;
      }

      body += "</section>";
      pager.addAtomic(body, heightMm);
    }

    if (systemBackup.period) {
      const body = '<section class="compact-section">' + nextSec(t.system_backup)
        + '<div class="sec-desc">' + escapeHtml(t.system_backup_desc) + "</div>"
        + '<div class="kpi-row">'
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-ok"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.protected_workloads + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.protected_workloads) + "</div></div>"
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.workstations + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.workstations) + "</div></div>"
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.servers + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.servers) + "</div></div>"
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.virtual_machines + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.vms) + "</div></div>"
        + "</div>"
        + '<div class="kpi-row">'
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-pct"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.backup_storage + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.backup_storage_tb) + '<em style="font-size:10pt"> TB</em></div></div>'
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-pct"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.dr_storage + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.dr_storage_tb) + '<em style="font-size:10pt"> TB</em></div></div>'
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-warn"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.dr_cloud_servers + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(systemBackup.dr_cloud_servers) + "</div></div>"
        + "</div>"
        + "</section>";
      pager.addAtomic(body, BLOCK_H_MM.compactSecHead + compactSecDescHeightMm(t.system_backup_desc) + BLOCK_H_MM.compactKpiRow * 2);
    }

    if (domainRegistration.domain) {
      const renewalDate = formatLongDate(domainRegistration.renewalDate, lang);
      const referenceDate = data.report_period
        ? data.report_period + "T00:00:00Z"
        : null;
      const remainingDays = daysUntilDate(
        domainRegistration.renewalDate,
        referenceDate
      );
      const renewalTone = remainingDays == null
        ? "kpi-neutral"
        : remainingDays < 90 ? "kpi-risk"
          : remainingDays < 180 ? "kpi-warn" : "kpi-ok";

      const body = '<section class="compact-section">' + nextSec(t.domain_management)
        + '<div class="sec-desc">' + escapeHtml(t.domain_management_desc) + "</div>"
        + '<div class="domain-strip">'
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.domain_name + '</div><div class="kpi-val" style="font-size:15pt">' + escapeHtml(String(domainRegistration.domain).toLowerCase()) + "</div></div>"
        + '<div class="kpi kpi-pct"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.renewal_date + '</div><div class="kpi-val" style="font-size:15pt">' + escapeHtml(renewalDate || t.unknown) + "</div></div>"
        + '<div class="kpi ' + renewalTone + '"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.days_remaining + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + escapeHtml(remainingDays == null ? t.unknown : remainingDays) + "</div></div>"
        + "</div></section>";
      pager.addAtomic(body, BLOCK_H_MM.compactSecHead + compactSecDescHeightMm(t.domain_management_desc) + BLOCK_H_MM.domainStrip);
    }
  }

  function renderAutomatedAlertsSection(pager) {
    const alerts = data.automated_alerts || {};
    if (alerts.totalActiveAlerts == null) return;

    const headHtml = nextSec(t.automated_alerts)
      + '<div class="sec-desc">' + escapeHtml(t.automated_alerts_desc) + "</div>"
      + '<div class="kpi-row">'
      + '<div class="kpi kpi-risk"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.total_active_alerts + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(alerts.totalActiveAlerts) + "</div></div>"
      + '<div class="kpi kpi-total"><div class="kpi-label">' + t.devices_with_alerts + '</div><div class="kpi-val">' + formatNumber(alerts.devicesWithAlerts) + "</div></div>"
      + "</div>";
    pager.addAtomic(headHtml, BLOCK_H_MM.secHead + secDescHeightMm(t.automated_alerts_desc) + BLOCK_H_MM.kpiRow);

    const alertDevices = Array.isArray(alerts.devices) ? alerts.devices : [];
    const rows = [];
    for (const device of alertDevices) {
      const deviceAlerts = Array.isArray(device.alerts) ? device.alerts : [];
      for (let i = 0; i < deviceAlerts.length; i++) {
        const alert = deviceAlerts[i];
        const message = alert?.clientMessage || t.unknown;
        rows.push({
          heightMm: estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(message, 76, ROW_HEIGHT_MM),
          html: "<tr><td>" + (i === 0 ? escapeHtml(device.deviceName || t.unknown) : "") + '</td><td style="white-space:normal">' + escapeHtml(message) + "</td><td>" + escapeHtml(alert?.dateDetected || t.unknown) + "</td></tr>"
        });
      }
    }
    if (rows.length) {
      const theadHtml = '<table><thead><tr><th>' + t.device_name + "</th><th>" + t.alert_message + '</th><th style="width:150px">' + t.date_detected + "</th></tr></thead>";
      const head = { html: "", heightMm: 0 };
      const continuedHead = { html: '<div class="sec-title">' + escapeHtml(t.automated_alerts) + " - " + escapeHtml(t.continued) + "</div>", heightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.secTitle };
      pager.addTableSection({ head, continuedHead, theadHtml, theadHeightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.tableHead, rows });
    }
  }

  function renderSharePointSection(pager) {
    if (!data.sharepoint_storage) return;
    const body = nextSec(t.sharepoint_storage)
      + '<div class="storage-block">'
      + '<div class="storage-label">' + escapeHtml(t.storage_usage) + "</div>"
      + '<div class="storage-value">' + escapeHtml(data.sharepoint_storage) + "</div>"
      + "</div>";
    pager.addAtomic(body, BLOCK_H_MM.secHead + BLOCK_H_MM.storageBlock);
  }

  /* ── Preferred Order ───────────────────────────────────────
     Executive Summary + Microsoft Secure Score render on page 1.
     Remaining sections render in the order documented at the top of
     this file, packed dynamically onto pages by the pager below
     (Device Security Inventory keeps its own bespoke per-card
     pagination and is spliced in between). ─────────────────────── */

  const pager = createPager();

  const licRows = buildLicenseRows(data.users);
  if (licRows.length) {
    const head = { html: '<div class="sec-title">' + escapeHtml(t.appendix_licenses) + "</div>", heightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.secTitle };
    const continuedHead = { html: '<div class="sec-title">' + escapeHtml(t.appendix_licenses) + " - " + escapeHtml(t.continued) + "</div>", heightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.secTitle };
    const theadHtml = '<table><thead><tr><th>' + t.license + '</th><th style="text-align:center">' + t.count + "</th></tr></thead>";
    const rows = licRows.map((row) => ({ heightMm: estimateWrappedRowHeightMm(row.name, 85, ROW_HEIGHT_MM), html: '<tr><td style="white-space:normal">' + escapeHtml(row.name) + '</td><td style="text-align:center">' + row.count + "</td></tr>" }));
    pager.addTableSection({ head, continuedHead, theadHtml, theadHeightMm: BLOCK_H_MM.tableHead, rows });
  }

  const { licensed: licensedUsers } = splitUsersByLicense(data.users);
  appendUserAuditPages(pager, t.appendix_a, t.microsoft_users_licensed, licensedUsers);
  appendUnlicensedEnabledUserPages(pager, t.appendix_b, t.microsoft_users_unlicensed, data.unlicensed_signin_enabled_users || []);

  renderGlobalAdminsSection(pager);
  renderSharePointSection(pager);
  renderEmailSecuritySection(pager);
  renderAutomatedAlertsSection(pager);
  renderEndpointSecuritySection(pager);

  const flowPagesBeforeDevices = pager.finish();
  const devicePages = appendDeviceInventoryPages();

  const continuityPager = createPager();
  renderContinuitySection(continuityPager);
  const continuityPages = continuityPager.finish();

  const allBodies = [page1Body, ...flowPagesBeforeDevices, ...devicePages, ...continuityPages];
  const totalPages = allBodies.length;
  allBodies.forEach((body, i) => {
    const pageClass = i === 0 ? "page page-compact" : "page force-page-break";
    html += '<div class="' + pageClass + '"><div class="hdr">' + hdrLabel + '</div><div class="page-body">' + body + "</div>" + pageFooter(i + 1, totalPages) + "</div>";
  });

  html += "</body></html>";
  return html;
}

/* ── n8n entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const items = $input.all();
let inputData = collectInputData(items);
let executiveSummary = "";
let language = "en";
let emailAddress = "";

for (const item of items) {
  const j = item.json || item;
  if (!j || typeof j !== "object") continue;

  if (typeof j.output === "string" && j.output.trim()) executiveSummary = j.output.trim();
  if (j.language != null) language = normalizeLanguage(j.language);
  if (j.Language != null) language = normalizeLanguage(j.Language);
  if (j.emailAddress != null) emailAddress = String(j.emailAddress);
  if (j["Email Address"] != null && !emailAddress) emailAddress = String(j["Email Address"]);
}

for (const section of inputData) {
  if (section && section.Language != null) {
    language = normalizeLanguage(section.Language);
    break;
  }
}

const parsed = parseSecurityData(inputData, executiveSummary);
const fullHtml = buildHtml(parsed, language);

return [{
  json: {
    html: fullHtml,
    client_name: parsed.client_name,
    language,
    emailAddress, 
    report_period: parsed.report_period
  }
}];
